skills.name: Domain of Beauty
skills.description:
Venus expands the Domain of Beauty, taunting all enemies and inflicting Infatuation for 5s. If a target is already Infatuated, their ATK is additionally reduced by 50% for 5s.
During the duration, Venus gains a shield every second equal to 8% of her Max HP.

upgrades.level2: Shield gained per second during the duration increases to 9% of Max HP.
upgrades.level3: Shield gained per second during the duration increases to 10% of Max HP.
upgrades.level4: Shield gained per second during the duration increases to 11% of Max HP.

skills.name: Morningstar Aegis
skills.description: Gains a shield equal to 20% of her Max HP, and recovers HP per second for the next 8s equal to 8% of her Max HP.

upgrades.level2: Shield gained increases to 25% of Max HP.
upgrades.level3: HP recovered per second over the next 8s increases to 12% of Max HP.
upgrades.level4: Shield gained increases to 30% of Max HP.

skills.name: Inviolable
skills.description: Passive: After taking cumulative DMG equal to 25% of her Max HP, Venus enters a DMG Immunity state for 3s. This effect can trigger at most once every 20s.

upgrades.level2: This effect can trigger at most once every 18s.
upgrades.level3: Cumulative DMG required to trigger is reduced to 20% of Max HP.
upgrades.level4: This effect can trigger at most once every 16s.

skills.name: Love at First Sight
skills.description: Passive: When battle starts, Venus inflicts Infatuation on the enemy unit with the highest ATK. (Infatuation: Reduces DMG dealt to Venus by 20%.)

upgrades.level2: Infatuation: Reduces DMG dealt to Venus by 23%.
upgrades.level3: Infatuation: Reduces DMG dealt to Venus by 26%.
upgrades.level4: Infatuation: Reduces DMG dealt to Venus by 30%.

relic.name: Gift of Paris
relic.description: Enhances [Inviolable], increasing its DMG Immunity duration to 4s.

upgrades.level2: When Venus's HP falls below 40% for the first time, triggers [Inviolable] 1 additional time.
upgrades.level3: Enhances [Love at First Sight]: Infatuation now reduces DMG dealt by the target to all allied units by 30%.
upgrades.level4: When [Inviolable] triggers, Venus taunts enemies within 3 meters around her for 3s. For every 1 enemy taunted by Venus on the field, Venus recovers 5% Max HP every 2s (triggers for up to 5 enemies).
